name: player_update_bank_velocity_from_steer_input
description: Player::UpdateBankVelocityFromSteerInput clears the restart yaw anchor and integrates local bank velocity from steering input, modal acceleration, and frame delta.

functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4283f0 shows a leaf update that reads playerState offsets 0x6c, 0x80, 0xb0, and 0x3c0 plus masterModalData accelRate at 0xa8 and g_Player_DeltaTime.

The native smoke covers neutral steering zeroing, same-direction velocity zeroing for positive and negative steering copies, restartYawRad clearing, and accelRate * deltaTime * steeringInputCopy integration into localVel.x.
